name: Titan NRG Inc.
summary: Through its various subsidiaries, Titan NRG Inc. operates as a downstream energy and transportation provider across the United States. The company manages a fleet of 25 transport vehicles that are active in nine states. In southern Arizona, it supplies retail and commercial propane, supported by approximately 1,500 leased storage tanks. Additionally, Titan NRG participates in the wholesale trading of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) products. A significant asset is its long-term lease on an 18-car rail facility located in Tucson, which provides an approved storage capacity of 1.2 million gallons for propane and butane. Established in 2001, the company maintains its principal office in Tucson, Arizona.
